description: Add up to 20 people to a Space with one role: editor (adds and changes things) or viewer (reads). Any email address works. Somebody with no account gets an invite email; somebody with one joins at once. Needs the owner or editor role. Returns one answer per address.

documentId.description: Open this document for an invited person after they sign in.
